[[10 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' gives HF-3311's age during the events of {{Film|IX}}, which dates [[35 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', as twenty-five [[Standard year|years]] old. Therefore, HF-3311 must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[10 ABY]]. |death= |species=[[Human]] |gender=[[Gender|Female]]{{Film|IX}} |pronouns=new |height=1.8 [[meter]]s |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[First Order]] **[[Stormtrooper Corps (First Order)|Stormtrooper Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Move, animal!|HF-3311 pushes Chewbacca into a transport|}} '''HF-3311''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from [[Gannaria]] who served as an [[First Order electroprod stormtrooper|electroprod trooper]] in the [[First Order]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. In [[35 ABY]], she aided the [[Knights of Ren]] in capturing the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] and remained with him while he was transported to the [[Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Take it to interrogation six.''"
"''Move it.|Enric Pryde gives orders to HF-3311|}} HF-3311 was the designation of a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was born on [[Gannaria]] around [[10 ABY]]. She served in the [[First Order]]'s [[Stormtrooper Corps (First Order)|Stormtrooper Corps]] as an [[First Order electroprod stormtrooper|electroprod trooper]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. In [[35 ABY]],{{FilmDate|IX|HF-3311's appearance}} she was amongst a [[division]] of First Order forces deployed on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] after [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] learned that the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] was on a [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|mission]] there. When the [[Knights of Ren]] [[Ap'lek]] and [[Kuruk]] spotted the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] alone in the [[desert]] on Pasaana, HF-3311 was amongst the [[stormtrooper]]s who aided them in capturing him. After a [[First Order officer|stormtrooper officer]] finished searching through the Wookiee's possessions, HF-3311 used her electroprod to force Chewbacca up a ramp into a [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport]]. The transport then carried them up to the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']] where [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] presented the prisoner to [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]]. After the Wookiee roared at Hux, Pryde ordered HF-3311 and the other troopers present to take the prisoner to interrogation six. Chewbacca later [[Mission to Kijimi|escaped]] from the [[Star Destroyer]], which was soon destroyed at the [[Battle of Exegol]]. ==Personality and traits== HF-3311 stood 1.8 [[meter]]s tall. ==Equipment== HF-3311 wore white [[First Order stormtrooper armor|stormtrooper armor]] and carried a [[Electroprod|riot control electroprod]]. ==Behind the scenes== HF-3311 was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Galactic Guide]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|HF-3311}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=HF-3311 |fr=HF-3311 |ka=HF-3311 }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:First Order stormtroopers]]
